tip-camp1.text: Welcome to Training Camp! Tap the ear when you are ready. Wait until I finish talking. Then do what I said.

tip-camp2.text: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

tip-camp3.text: Listen for the tricky words: not, all, except, next to, left, and right.

tip-camp4.text: Before and after. Sometimes I say it backwards. Think: what comes first?

tip-camp5.text: Only do it if it is a real order. If it is not, tap the hand.

tip-camp-boss.text: Camp Boss! Three and four steps, tricky words, and changes of plan. Beat me to open every world.

tip-memory1.text: Welcome to Memory Mountain! Three things to tap, and the colors matter. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

tip-memory2.text: Four steps now. Here is a trick: count them on your fingers while I talk. Then tap one thing for each finger.

tip-memory3.text: Three steps with colors again. But now the cards are hidden while I talk. Listen first. Make a picture of each one in your mind. Then look.

tip-memory4.text: Five steps! Take a breath. Say the list back in your head, like a little song. Then tap them one at a time.

tip-memory5.text: Opposite order means backwards. If I say the key, the gem, and the star, you tap the star first, then the gem, then the key. Start with the last thing I said.

tip-memory6.text: Two new tricks. If I say, skip the second one, leave out the second thing I said. And listen for how many times to tap each thing. Once, two times, or three times.

tip-memory7.text: The top of the mountain! Six steps in a row. And sometimes three hidden things, with a size and a color for each one. Breathe, listen to the end, and picture them.

tip-memory-boss.text: Summit boss! Backwards lists, skipping, counting, and six steps. Listen all the way to the end. Then go one step at a time.

tip-logic3.text: Welcome to the Logic Lab! First, think about groups. Things you can wear, like a hat or a ring. Animals, like a cat. Things that can fly. Tap every one that fits. Then press the green check mark.

tip-logic1.text: Now everything is in one row. Listen for the side to start counting from: the left, or the right. If I say the second red one, count only the red ones.

tip-logic2.text: One row again, but now some things look the same. Listen for what is beside each one. Next to. Between. To the left of. Only one of them fits.

tip-logic4.text: Two clues at once. Red and small means it must be both. Neither blue nor big means it is not blue, and it is not big. Tap all that fit. Then the green check mark.

tip-logic5.text: Time to count and compare. Count each kind first. Are there more, or fewer, or just as many? Then decide what to tap.

tip-logic6.text: Tricky words: unless, and only if. Tap the star, unless there is a dragon. So if you see a dragon, do not tap anything. Press the hand instead. Only if means: do it just when that is true.

tip-logic7.text: I will give you two orders, but only one is right. Check what is true. Then do only that one, in the right order, and press the green check mark.

tip-logic-boss.text: Lab boss! Count, compare, unless, and only if. Think before you tap. If there is nothing you should do, press the hand.

tip-pack1.text: Welcome to Move and Pack! Tap a thing to pick it up. Then tap the place where it goes. When you have finished, press the green check mark.

tip-pack2.text: Two things to move now. Listen for the color or the size, and for where: in, on, or under. Made a slip? Tap the thing to take it out again.

tip-pack3.text: Now listen for how many. If I say three coins, move three. Not two, and not four. Count what is inside before you press the green check mark.

tip-pack4.text: Sorting time! All means every single one. Everything red means every red thing, whatever it is. And except means that one stays on the shelf.

tip-pack5.text: Now the order matters. Listen for first, then, before, after, and not until. Sometimes I say it backwards. So stop and think: which one do I move first? The little numbers show your order.

tip-pack6.text: Now there is an if. Look at the shelf before you move anything. Unless there is a crown means: if you see a crown, move nothing. And if there is nothing you should move, tap the hand.

tip-pack7.text: Memory time! Everything hides while I talk. Say the list back in your head. Then pack it all, and press the green check mark.

tip-pack-boss.text: Pack Boss! Orders, ifs, and packing from memory, all mixed up. Stop and think before you move. Beat me to clear this world.

tip-paint1.text: Welcome to the Paint Shop! Tap a paint pot, then tap the thing to paint it. When it looks right, press the green check mark.

tip-paint2.text: Two paint jobs now. Made a slip? Tap the sponge with the bubbles, then the thing, to wash it clean. Or press the arrow to take it back.

tip-paint3.text: Now listen for big or small. Two things can look the same, so the size tells you which one to paint.

tip-paint4.text: Tricky words: ALL and EXCEPT. All means every one that fits. Except means leave that one alone, with no paint at all.

tip-paint5.text: Now they stand in one row. The first one is on the left, like reading. The last one is on the right. Listen for where: second from the right, in the middle, between, next to.

tip-paint6.text: Tricky words. Unless they are keys means: the keys do not get that paint. Neither a drum nor a gem means: not a drum, and not a gem. Listen for NOT and IF too. Some things get no paint at all.

tip-paint7.text: Now the things are hidden while I talk, and there are three or four paint jobs. Say each one back in your head. Then paint.

tip-paint-boss.text: Paint Boss! Rows, tricky words, and painting from memory, all mixed up. Listen all the way to the end.

tip-build1.text: Welcome to the Robot Workshop! I tell you what the robot looks like. Tap one picture in each row to build it. When your robot is ready, tap the green check mark.

tip-build2.text: Now the robot needs three parts. Listen to all of them before you start. Picked the wrong one? Tap another picture in that row, or tap the arrow to take it back.

tip-build3.text: Listen for the word not. Sometimes I only tell you what the robot does not have. Then look along the row and work out which picture is left.

tip-build4.text: Now listen for numbers. How many eyes, how many antennas, how many buttons? Each number belongs to one part, so do not mix them up.

tip-build5.text: Now you have to compare. Listen for words like longest, bigger, more and fewer. Twice as many means two times as many. Look along the whole row before you choose.

tip-build6.text: Listen for if and unless. Unless means: but not when. Neither red nor blue means: not red and not blue. The first picture is on the left, like reading. If I change my mind, build the new part.

tip-build7.text: Now the pictures stay hidden while I talk. Listen to all five parts and keep them in your head. Build the robot when the pictures turn over.

tip-build-boss.text: The Workshop Boss! Hard robots, tricky words and some hidden pictures. Take your time. Listen to the very end, then build.

tip-route1.text: Steer the rover with the four big arrows. Up, down, left and right mean the directions on the screen. One tap moves one square. Then press the green check mark.

tip-route2.text: Now the route has a turn in it. Drive the first part, then turn and drive the next part. Made a slip? The thin arrow next to the round arrow takes one move back.

tip-route3.text: Now I name a place on the map. Drive the rover there any way you like, and stop on its square. Then press the green check mark.

tip-route4.text: Now there are stops on the way. Drive to each place in the order I say, and finish on the last one. Driving past other places is fine. The numbers show where you have been.

tip-route5.text: Now there are rules. Do not touch means: never drive onto that square. To pick a thing up, drive over it. Except means: leave that one out. Listen for the words not and only.

tip-route6.text: Tricky orders! Sometimes I say the last stop first. Think: what comes first? Sometimes the map decides. Only if it is red means: when it is red, do it. When it is not red, leave it alone.

tip-route7.text: Long routes from memory! The map hides while I talk. Say the route in your head, then drive it. The round arrow lets you hear it one more time.

tip-route-boss.text: Route Boss! Rules, tricky orders and long routes from memory. To pick a thing up, drive over it. Do not touch means never drive onto it. Think before you drive.

tip-panel1.text: Welcome to the Control Room! Round buttons are for pressing. Switches flip up and down. Listen for the color, and for button or switch. Then do it.

tip-panel2.text: Now listen for how many times, and for two things in order. Little dots count your presses. When you are done, press the green check mark. The arrow takes one back.

tip-panel3.text: Here is the dial. It shows one number. The plus button makes the number go up. The minus button makes it go down. Set it to the number I say.

tip-panel4.text: Now the number pad. I will tell you a code. Type the numbers in the same order. The little screen shows what you typed. The big rocket button is launch.

tip-panel5.text: Longer orders now. Codes with five numbers, and three things to do in a row. Say them in your head while you listen. Keep them in the same order.

tip-panel6.text: Tricky words now. Before and after can be said backwards. Except means leave that one out. Backwards means start with the last number. The light is red or green. Sometimes it decides what you do.

tip-panel7.text: Blackout! The controls stay covered while I talk, so remember everything. The light is red or green, and sometimes it decides what you do. Look at it when the cover opens.

tip-panel-boss.text: Control Room Boss! Long codes, tricky words, and covered controls. Listen to every word. Then take your time and check your work before the green check mark.

tip-truth1.text: Look at the picture and listen to what I say about it. If it is true, tap the green check mark. If it is not true, tap the cross.

tip-truth2.text: Now you have to count. It is only true if the number is exactly right. When I have finished talking, you can touch the things in the picture to mark them as you count.

tip-truth3.text: Listen for three little words. All means every single one. None means not even one. Some means a few of them. Check each one in the picture.

tip-truth4.text: Now we compare. More means a bigger number. Fewer means a smaller number. As many means the very same number. Look at both groups before you choose.

tip-truth5.text: Everything stands in one row now. Listen for where things are: next to, between, left, right, the end, and the middle. Exactly in the middle means the same number on each side.

tip-truth6.text: Now I say two things in one sentence. Check them both. Listen for the little words: and, but, not, either, neither, except. Neither means not this one, and not that one.

tip-truth7.text: The hardest test. The picture is covered while I talk, so hold the whole sentence in your head. Both parts must be true. All but one means every one except one. Then look and choose.

tip-truth-boss.text: Truth Boss! Rows, two facts at once, and covered pictures. Listen to every word, check every part, and then decide. You can do it.

tip-stories1.text: Welcome to Story Cave! Listen to the whole story. Keep track of who has what, because things get swapped. Then tap the answer to my question.

tip-stories2.text: Now listen for the order things happen in. I will ask what came right before, or right after. Tap the thing from that part of the story.

tip-stories3.text: In these stories, things get moved around. Follow every move, like a movie in your mind. Then tap where the thing is, or who has it.

tip-stories4.text: Now I will ask why something happened. Many things are in the story, but only one of them caused it. Tap the thing that made it happen.

tip-stories5.text: Be a detective. I will never say the name of the answer. Listen to every clue, and rule out what does not fit. Then tap what it must be.

tip-stories6.text: Sometimes the cards are hidden while I talk. Then tap the one thing that was not in the story. Other times, tap only the ones that fit my question, not the rest, and press the green check mark.

tip-stories7.text: The hardest stories. Tap the things in the order they really happened. Then press the green check mark. The arrow takes back a slip. Listen to the very end. Plans can change!

tip-stories-boss.text: Story Boss! Clues, lists, and stories told out of order. Make a movie in your mind, and listen all the way to the end.

tip-legend1.text: Legend Trial one. A different challenge every turn. Listen to every word.

tip-legend2.text: Legend Trial two. Stay calm, breathe, and listen all the way to the end.

tip-legend-boss.text: The final boss. Only the hardest challenge from every world. You are ready.

tip-w1l1.text: Welcome to Rookie Camp! Here is how it works. Tap the ear when you are ready to listen. Wait until I finish talking. Then tap what I said.

tip-w1l2.text: Now listen for the color. Some of them look the same, so the color tells you which one.

tip-w1l3.text: This time, listen for big or small.

tip-w1l4.text: Two clues now: the color, and the thing. You need both.

tip-w1l5.text: Three clues! The size, the color, and the thing. Here is a trick: say it back in your head.

tip-w1l6.text: Sometimes the important part comes at the very end. Keep listening until I stop talking.

tip-w1l7.text: Camp challenge! A mix of everything you have learned so far.

tip-w2l1.text: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

tip-w2l2.text: Two steps, with colors. Here is a trick: make a picture of each one in your mind.

tip-w2l4.text: This time the cards are hidden while I talk. Listen first, hold it in your head, then look.

tip-w2l5.text: Two steps, and the cards are hidden. Say them back in your head while you wait.

tip-w2l6.text: Trail boss! Two steps, counting, and hidden cards, all mixed up.

tip-w3l1.text: Tricky word alert: NOT. Listen for the one I do not want.

tip-w3l2.text: When I say ALL, tap every one that fits. Then press the green check mark.

tip-w3l3.text: Tricky word: EXCEPT. Except means: leave that one out.

tip-w3l4.text: Now listen for where things are. Next to. Between. In the middle.

tip-w3l5.text: Left and right. Here is a trick: hold up both hands with your thumbs sticking out. The hand that makes an L is your left.

tip-w3l6.text: Woods challenge! Not, all, except, and where. Listen for the tricky word.

tip-w4l1.text: First, then, last. These words tell you the order.

tip-w4l4.text: Careful! Sometimes I say it backwards. Before you eat, wash your hands. So washing comes first. Listen for BEFORE, and think: what comes first?

tip-w4l5.text: Careful again. Eat after you wash your hands. Washing still comes first. Listen for AFTER, and think: what comes first?

tip-w4l6.text: Tower boss! Before and after, all mixed up. Think: what happens first?

tip-w5l1.text: Captain’s rule: only do it if I say, Captain says. If I do not say Captain says, tap the hand.

tip-w5l2.text: Sneaky pirates are giving orders too. Only listen to the captain.

tip-w5l3.text: IF is a tricky word. If it is true, do it. If it is not true, tap the hand.

tip-w5l4.text: Now there are two choices. If it is true, do the first thing. If not, do the second.

tip-w5l5.text: Sometimes I change my mind at the end. Wait until I have completely finished.

tip-w5l6.text: Captain’s test! Wait for every word before you move.

tip-w6l1.text: Three steps now. Here is a trick: count them on your fingers as you listen.

tip-w6l2.text: Three steps, with colors. Say them back in your head.

tip-w6l3.text: Three steps, and the cards are hidden. You can do it. Picture each one.

tip-w6l4.text: Four steps! Take a breath, listen all the way, and go one at a time.

tip-w6l5.text: Mountain boss! Long instructions. Breathe, listen, and go one step at a time.

tip-w7l1.text: Story time! Listen to the story, then answer my question.

tip-w7l2.text: These stories are a bit longer. Make a movie in your mind as you listen.

tip-w7l3.text: Listen for what happens first, next, and last.

tip-w7l4.text: Be a detective. I will not tell you the answer. Use the clues to work it out.

tip-w7l5.text: Cave boss! Stories and clues. Make a movie in your mind.

tip-w8l1.text: Hero’s Trial, part one. Clues, steps, and tricky words.

tip-w8l2.text: Hero’s Trial, part two. Wait for the real order, and remember every step.

tip-w8l3.text: The Legend Run. Everything you have learned. You are ready.

hello-first.text: Hi John! I am Blip, your guide. Let’s train your super listening. Tap the glowing level to start.

wait-please.text: John, please try your best to listen until I am finished talking.

skip-hint.text: Too easy? Beat the boss to skip ahead. It is the gold star.

reward-won.text: You earned a reward! Go and show a grown-up.

chore-sent.text: Nice work! A grown-up will check it soon.

expect-done.text: All done, John! Your rewards are unlocked.

rewards-locked.text: First, finish your expectations. Then your rewards will open.

reward-locked.text: You earned a reward! Finish your expectations to unlock it.

hello-back-2.text: Good to see you, John! Ready to train?

goodEnd-1.text: Nice! You listened to every word.

goodEnd-2.text: You listened all the way to the end. Nice!

goodEnd-3.text: You waited until I finished. Nice!

goodWait-2.text: You waited until I finished. Nice!

goodWait-3.text: That is how a captain listens.

retry-1.text: Not quite. Listen one more time.

watch-1.text: Watch. Here is how it goes.

watch-2.text: Let me show you this one.

watch-3.text: That was a tricky one. Watch me.

result3-2.text: Wow! Every single one on the first try!

result2-2.text: Awesome job. You earned two stars!

result1-1.text: Mission complete, John! Every mission makes your listening stronger.

result1-2.text: You finished the mission! Want to try for two stars?

enough-1.text: Great training today, John! This is a good place to stop. See you next time!
